claims: The 2026 Masters has a record total purse of $22.5 million.
The winner of the 2026 Masters takes home $4.5 million.
The 2026 Masters purse is the largest payout in golf's four majors.
The runner-up in the 2026 Masters earns $2.43 million.
Third place in the 2026 Masters earns $1.53 million.
All professionals who miss the cut in the 2026 Masters receive $25,000.
Fourth place in the 2026 Masters receives $1,080,000.
Fifth place in the 2026 Masters receives $900,000.
Sixth place in the 2026 Masters receives $810,000.
Seventh place in the 2026 Masters receives $753,750.
Eighth place in the 2026 Masters receives $697,500.
Ninth place in the 2026 Masters receives $652,500.
Tenth place in the 2026 Masters receives $607,500.
The 2026 Masters winner's share of $4.5 million matches the largest on the PGA Tour.
More than $17 million of the 2026 Masters total purse is distributed to the top 15 finishers.
Payouts for ties in the 2026 Masters are calculated by splitting the total money allotted for those positions.
